name: Self-Forcing
model_version: Self-Forcing self_forcing_dmd.pt (generator_ema; chunk-wise AR, 4-step DMD, no CFG) on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B; code guandeh17/Self-Forcing@33593df3e81f

weights.repo: gdhe17/Self-Forcing@2f8b7792 (checkpoints/self_forcing_dmd.pt) + Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B (umT5-XXL text encoder, Wan2.1 VAE, DiT config)

notes: Text-to-video only: an opening image cannot be given, so the image + text (i2v) track is not registered. 832x480 at 16 fps, 3-latent (12-frame) causal blocks generated live (4 DMD steps 1000/750/500/250, shift 5.0). The released checkpoint is a 5-second model: sessions continue past 21 latent frames with upstream's rolling KV cache (local attention 21 latents), which the checkpoint was not trained for. It has no prompt-switch mechanism: the block prompt '<init prompt>\n<latest instruction>' is re-encoded and the cross-attention cache reset at the next block; camera_control text is given as prompt text because the model has no camera input.
